status: Three-port exploded architecture view. Board separation and cable paths are illustrative; no mating, collision or signal-integrity proof.

fpga25t.export: KiCad 10.0.6 pcb export glb; unavailable U1/U9 package bodies omitted from native export. Viewer adds an illustrative 15 x 15 mm U1 body. Board contains no routed tracks.

xem8310.conversion: OpenCascade STEP tessellation to glTF binary, official CAD geometry in mm and CAD Z-up; board and mating connectors kept at full tessellation, other components simplified for the browser; illustrative colors
xem8310.mating_transform_in_brk_cad_mm: rotate 180 degrees around CAD Z, then translate (+167.65,+96.90,+6.395) for the nominal direct XEM-on-BRK stack
xem8310.viewer: Both models are centered independently for an exploded architecture view. XEM is rotated 180 degrees in-plane and centered about (+34.825,-3.85) relative to BRK in viewer X/Z. Vertical gap is illustrative.

brk8310.conversion: OpenCascade STEP tessellation to glTF binary, official CAD geometry in mm and CAD Z-up; board and mating connectors kept at full tessellation, other components simplified for the browser; illustrative colors

interposer.export: KiCad 10.0.6 pcb export glb --include-tracks --include-pads --include-silkscreen; native project is partial: 160 MC1/MC2 contacts and one MC3-to-Type-D pair routed; 119 unconnected items; 61 conservative 0.20 mm physical DRC violations, zero geometry violations only under conditional 0.15 mm study rule. The 12 V protection/JTAG circuits are schematic placeholders, not placed. Six stack connector 3D bodies are missing from this export.
interposer.frame: KiCad export is in metres and Y-up. Viewer scales by 1000 and independently centers the geometry. In imported BRK KiCad XY, board outline x124.4..232.3261, y65.1536..135.1536 mm; subtract (64.676,38.254) mm to map to official BRK STEP XY. In viewer, its center sits x+29.86 mm, z-3.85 mm relative to BRK center; vertical exploded gap is illustrative.
